card.name: Last word inside a closing parenthesis
card.fires_on: The final word or number just before a closing parenthesis, in a parenthetical aside such as an abbreviation, a unit, a tablet count, or a percentage in a dosing or results table.

modes.label: Parenthetical dose or unit
modes.description: The last word of a bracketed dose explanation or unit, right before the closing bracket.

modes.label: Abbreviation or number in brackets
modes.description: The end of an abbreviation, percentage or citation number that sits inside parentheses.

card.writes: It promotes closing-bracket and closing-quote tokens and suppresses tokens that follow a bracket, such as colons and periods.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a parenthetical remark is about to close, such as a tablet count, an abbreviation or a percentage.
